findings.question: Emergency calls and public-safety radio: the body that operates it
findings.quote: Dansk Beredskabskommunikation A/S er leverandør af SINE og står for driften af beredskabernes fælles radionet.
findings.quote_english: Dansk Beredskabskommunikation A/S is the supplier of SINE and is responsible for operating the emergency services' shared radio network.
findings.value: Dansk Beredskabskommunikation A/S (supplier and operator of SINE, the emergency services' shared radio network)
findings.title: Leverandør
findings.note: This is CFB's own site and supports the network-operation clause that the om-cfb page lacked. The page also says CFB manages the contract, which the state renewed in 2023 with service planned from 1 April 2026; it covers public-safety radio only, not emergency calls.

review.reason: The quote appears verbatim and states that Dansk Beredskabskommunikation A/S supplies SINE and runs the emergency services' shared radio network.
